source.where: games.fun research/studio-v2/evals/gauntlet/kinds.json (2026-10-11), "board-card", itself the X2 experiment's prompt (2026-10-10): pitched as something else (no turns)

prompt: giant four in a row with friends

ledger.means: A grid board that pieces drop into
The board is giant: players see it as a big thing in the world, not a small panel
Players take turns, one piece each
Four in a line wins; a full board is a draw
Friends play each other at the same board

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.
multiplayer.note: What "sees friends as a character" means for a board game is an open creator question (DESIGN, "Still open"). Until they answer, this case reads it as: each screen shows the other player as a character at the board, or, when the game has no bodies, as a named marker where they are about to play.

control.text: The game includes a working fishing minigame
